final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.telescref AS telescope_id, o.weathprofile AS weather_condition, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry COLLATE BINARY JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modulation_index) AS overall_avg_modulation_index FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.weather_condition, step1.avg_modulation_index, step1.avg_phase_shift, step1.avg_modulation_index - step2.overall_avg_modulation_index AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg_modulation_index IS NOT NULL WHERE step1.avg_modulation_index > step2.overall_avg_modulation_index) SELECT weather_condition, AVG(avg_modulation_index) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(difference) AS avg_difference FROM step3 GROUP BY weather_condition
